children: Colosseum has launched the Tempo track, the second dedicated hackathon track for Crypto World's Fair, with support from Tempo. According to ChainCatcher, the track will award a combined $100,000 to the top 10 startups that integrate with the Tempo blockchain. Participants can register through the event page.

title: Colosseum Launches Tempo Track for Crypto World's Fair Hackathon
